name: ROAD CLOSED
spec: white horizontal rectangle with black legend ROAD CLOSED
meaning: The road ahead is closed to all traffic.

snippets.back: Do not move or go around barriers or signs to cross onto a road closed to traffic.
Flash flooding kills more people than any other roadway weather event each year, so never drive around barricades or past road closed signs.
Barrels, cones, tubes and barriers identify restricted work areas, and a Road Closed barrier prevents entry.
ROAD CLOSED FLOODING means the road ahead is closed by flooding and the driver must take another route.
Flood waters may wash away or undermine bridges, culverts and roadbeds, so never drive around traffic barricades or past road closed signs, and obey every detour sign.
A Road Closed sign prohibits entry to the work zone except by authorized personnel.
